moa: SGLT2 inhibitor plus biguanide fixed-dose combination

approval_evidence.quote: Original Approvals or Tentative Approvals ... 10/29/2014 ORIG-1 Approval Type 4 - New Combination STANDARD (NDA 205649, Company: ASTRAZENECA AB; XIGDUO XR DAPAGLIFLOZIN; METFORMIN HYDROCHLORIDE TABLET, EXTENDED RELEASE;ORAL)

annual_basis: Calendar years 2014-2023 from the US product sales columns of the 'Patent Expiries of Key Marketed Products' table in AstraZeneca's annual report / Form 20-F for each year (2014 and 2015 are prior-year columns of the 2016 report, the first to print the line).
series_start_reason: The 2016 annual report (exhibit 15.1 to the 20-F filed 2017-03-07) is the first to print Xigduo with US sales for 2016, 2015 and 2014 (99, 32, 2). The 2015 annual report prints no Xigduo row in that table.
series_end_reason: The 20-F filed 2025-02-18 (2024) no longer gives Xigduo/Xigduo XR a sales figure: footnote 8 says 'Xigduo/Xigduo XR revenues are combined with Farxiga/Forxiga'. 2023 (112) is the last year printed.
notes: Scope is the US column of the row labelled 'Xigduo' (2014-2017 reports) or 'Xigduo/ Xigduo XR' (2018 onward). The label covers the twice-daily Xigduo (sold outside the US) and the extended-release Xigduo XR (US label, FDA NDA 205649); the US column is therefore Xigduo XR sales, which is an inference from the label, not stated by the issuer. These US sales are also inside the US Farxiga line (the 20-F for 2022 states Xigduo/Xigduo XR sales are included in Farxiga sales). The ex-US column changed definition (China, Japan and Europe aggregate until the 2020 report, all non-US from the 2021 20-F), so only the US column is used for the whole series. Values are as printed in each year's own report; later reports repeat them unchanged (e.g. 2019 103 in the 2019, 2020 and 2021 reports).

no_quarterly_series.source_quote: Xigduo/Xigduo XR Product Sales is included in the Farxiga Product Sales figure.
no_quarterly_series.details: AstraZeneca's quarterly results releases (6-K, 2014Q1-2026Q2) contain no numeric row for the brand: every occurrence is a pipeline/launch-status row or text. Only the annual Report/20-F 'Patent Expiries of Key Marketed Products' table gives US and ex-US sales per year, as shown in this series.

search_log: Listed every AstraZeneca PLC (CIK 0000901832) filing via data.sec.gov submissions (recent plus older pages; 2,052 filings, all form types).

Downloaded the main document of all 1,646 filings of form 6-K, 6-K/A, 20-F and 20-F/A that carry a primary document (2002-2026) and scanned them: HTML table rows by label, plain text for the 2002-2003 .txt releases; 2002 6-Ks before November 2002 are scanned paper documents (.paper) and were not readable.
Latest results document used: the Q2 2026 results 6-K filed 2026-07-27 (0001104659-26-086846); no later results release exists as of the search date.
Bigdata.com was available but not needed; every figure was read from the sec.gov original, never from a Bigdata.com link.

Scanned all 75 HTML results documents mentioning Xigduo, Kombiglyze or Komboglyze for table rows starting with those names and holding at least three figures: only the 20-F for 2021, 2022 and 2023 match (Product Sales are never broken out in the quarterly releases).

Annual reports (exhibit 15.1, 2016-2020) are text blocks, not tables; the six figures after the product description were read as US(3 years) then non-US(3 years) and cross-checked: each report's second and third US figures equal the previous reports' first and second (e.g. 114, 134, 99 in the 2018 report; 134, 99, 32 in the 2017 report).

Farxiga reconciliation in the 20-F for 2022: Farxiga world 4,381 = 3,671 printed in the key-marketed-products row + Xigduo 710 (US 111 + ex-US 599), confirming the Xigduo figures are components of the Farxiga line.
Before 2014: BMS printed 'Forxiga/Xigduo' as one line (BMS 10-K for 2013), before Xigduo XR's October 2014 US approval; not used.
20-F filed 2025-02-18 and 2026-02-24: no Xigduo sales figure (combined with Farxiga/Forxiga).
